_contract: Single source of truth for what the BlueSkyz Labs portfolio website may publicly say about Sổ Trọ. The SGPS-Marketing repo (src/content/products/sotro.yaml) vendors a snapshot of this file pinned to an exact Sotro main revision and fails its own tests on drift. To change any public claim, change this file FIRST (via a reviewed Sotro PR), then re-vendor it in SGPS-Marketing at the new exact revision. Fields prefixed with an underscore are documentation for maintainers and must not be rendered publicly. Guard: tests/unit/public-profile.test.ts.

_rationale.availability: Committed production config (wrangler.jsonc env.production.vars) is PUBLIC_EXPOSURE_LEVEL=L4_PAID with SELF_REGISTRATION_ENABLED=true, TURNSTILE_ENABLED=true and PUBLIC_WORKSPACE_CAP=9, and src/app/router.tsx serves the public /dang-ky sign-up page. So a new landlord can create a workspace today, but only a small, capped number of workspaces exist. Owner 2026-10-15 asked to present Sổ Trọ as a preview that is close to Go-Live: lifecycle 'beta' + availability 'preview' + publicLabel 'Preview' says exactly that (an early, open-to-try web product with limited places), not 'Available'. Do not move to 'public'/'Available' until the workspace cap is lifted and Go-Live is approved. Guard (c) and (h) in tests/unit/public-profile.test.ts tie these values to the committed config.
_rationale.paid: Paid Go-Live is not approved. PAID_ORDERS_ENABLED=true in production only serves a bounded, server-enforced canary (PAYMENT_CANARY_MODE=ENFORCE, one designated workspace, a fixed window); docs/release/L4_PROMOTION_RECORD_2026-10-12.md is a DRAFT. No price, plan or purchase claim may be published.
_rationale.capabilities: Only behaviour that is merged on main, routed in production and has code plus a test in this repo (feature census 2026-10-15 at main 2f29c772). Deliberately NOT claimed: tiered electricity billing (invoices use the landlord's flat rate; the tier breakdown is only an advisory comparison), automatic sending of reminders or receipts (both are copy-only), automatic bank matching (the transfer QR only shows a code; the landlord still confirms the money), a PIN to reveal ID numbers (none exists), full offline use, and anything from the dormant premium work. Public strings and evidence paths avoid bank-QR standard names because the website's no-payment-authority guard scans the vendored copy.
_rationale.signInUrl: Committed production APP_BASE_URL is https://sotro.blueskyzlabs.com and src/app/router.tsx serves /login on the main (non-admin, non-super) host.
_rationale.listing: Owner 2026-09-30: Sổ Trọ is the portfolio flagship and the first product planned for Go-Live, so it stays listed (public, hero, first) rather than hidden. Listing it is not a claim of open access: availability/publicLabel above still govern what a visitor can do.
_rationale.nativeApps: Owner 2026-09-30: native Android and iOS apps are planned after the web core is complete and will sync with the same workspace. No native project exists in this repo yet, so both are 'in-development' with no store link, and platforms stays ['web'].
_rationale.signUpUrl: SELF_REGISTRATION_ENABLED=true and TURNSTILE_ENABLED=true in production, and src/app/router.tsx serves path="/dang-ky" (public Register page, tests/e2e/public/register-page.spec.ts). The link is published only while self-registration is on; guard (h) removes the permission the moment the flag is turned off.

name: Sổ Trọ
jobs: See at a glance who still owes rent this month and what needs doing today
Collect rent and record each payment once, correctly, without a spreadsheet
Keep rooms, tenants, meter readings and the residence register in one place

Large text and big buttons built for older landlords; a family helper's phone joins by scanning a QR code
A month-readiness view of who still owes and what is due, plus a C06 residence spreadsheet to download
